selection.requires: Explicit ENABLE_MEDIA_POLICY at the native controlled composition; never changes accepted baseline source policies

contracts.clock: Continuous compute clock; the existing audio_clk domain, not selected MCLK
contracts.command: Held command payload must be stable for one predecode edge before command_valid, as provided by timing.apb
contracts.cpu_event: Existing 18-bit event; only a legal CPU event write can backpressure the mailbox
contracts.record: One authoritative REC_ENABLE; existing 96-bit packets and POP/RELEASE; opt-in seal preserves FIFO/snapshot across CPU-only reset and publishes object id, recorded 48000Hz format, source epoch, exact accepted count and explicit failures
contracts.score: Resident 256-cue player; policy hold fences starts; planned stop has cancellation status and suppresses same-edge successful completion
contracts.parameters: Only forwards events and observes committed state; does not own common parameters
contracts.effect_state: Read-only 0x1b8: bit8 master, bits7:6 appended count, bits5:0 ordered stage IDs. Direct compute-domain observation; existing 0x1a0 sequence brackets coherent UI reads. No new parameter owner.

limits: Legacy bounded recorder remains 48kHz only. This phase adds no DDR long recording, BLE recording/download, dual-rate capture, new MIDI CC, synthesis, P&R or hardware acceptance.
